CREATE FUNCTION CDN.KntSzukaj( @pwk smallint = 1, -- 0 - tylko klienci knt, 1 - klienci knt i pwk @sound smallint = 1, -- 0 - nie uwzględniaj SoundExPl, 1 - uwzględniaj @akronim varchar(20) = '', @nazwa varchar (50) = '', @miasto varchar (30) = '', @adres varchar (30) = '', @nip varchar (13) = '', @osoba varchar (40) = '' ) RETURNS @varret table ( szk_TypKlient smallint, -- 1 - klient knt , 2 - klient pwk szk_GidTyp smallint, szk_GidFirma int, szk_GidNumer int, szk_GidLp smallint ) AS BEGIN declare @inne bit declare @soundTmp varchar (20) declare @nipTmp varchar (13)
if @akronim = '' and @nazwa = '' and @miasto = '' and @adres = '' and @nip = '' set @inne = 0 else set @inne = 1
if @inne = 0 and @osoba = '' begin insert @varret select 1, knt_gidtyp, knt_gidfirma, knt_gidnumer, knt_gidlp from cdn.kntkarty if @pwk = 1 insert @varret select 2, pwk_gidtyp, pwk_gidfirma, pwk_gidnumer, 0 from pwkkarty return end
if @inne = 0 and @osoba <> '' begin insert @varret select distinct 1, knt_gidtyp, knt_gidfirma, knt_gidnumer, knt_gidlp from cdn.kntkarty join cdn.kntosoby on knt_gidtyp = kns_knttyp and knt_gidfirma = kns_kntfirma and knt_gidnumer = kns_kntnumer where kns_nazwa like '%' + @osoba + '%' return end
if @sound = 1 and @akronim <> '' set @soundTmp = cdn.SoundExPl ( @akronim ) else if @sound = 1 and @nazwa <> '' set @soundTmp = cdn.SoundExPl ( @nazwa ) else set @soundTmp = ''
if @nip <> '' set @nipTmp = Replace ( @nip , '-' , '' ) else set @nipTmp = ''
if @inne = 1 and @osoba = '' begin
insert @varret select 1, knt_gidtyp, knt_gidfirma, knt_gidnumer, knt_gidlp from cdn.kntkarty where (knt_akronim like @akronim + '%' and isnull(knt_nazwa1,'')+isnull(knt_nazwa2,'')+isnull(knt_nazwa3,'') like '%' + @nazwa + '%' and isnull(knt_miasto,'') like '%'+ @miasto + '%' and isnull(knt_ulica,'') like '%' + @adres + '%' and isnull(knt_nip,'') like @nipTmp + '%' ) or ( @soundTmp <> '' and knt_soundex = @soundTmp )
if @pwk = 1 begin insert @varret select 2, pwk_gidtyp, pwk_gidfirma, pwk_gidnumer, 0 from pwkkarty where isnull(pwk_nazwa1,'')+isnull(pwk_nazwa2,'')+isnull(pwk_nazwa3,'') like '%' + @nazwa + '%' and isnull(pwk_miasto,'') like '%'+ @miasto + '%' and isnull(pwk_ulica,'') like '%' + @adres + '%' and isnull(pwk_nip,'') like @nipTmp + '%' end
return
end
insert @varret select 1, knt_gidtyp, knt_gidfirma, knt_gidnumer, knt_gidlp from cdn.kntkarty left join cdn.kntosoby on knt_gidtyp = kns_knttyp and knt_gidfirma = kns_kntfirma and knt_gidnumer = kns_kntnumer where (knt_akronim like @akronim + '%' and isnull(knt_nazwa1,'')+isnull(knt_nazwa2,'')+isnull(knt_nazwa3,'') like '%' + @nazwa + '%' and isnull(knt_miasto,'') like '%'+ @miasto + '%' and isnull(knt_ulica,'') like '%' + @adres + '%' and isnull(knt_nip,'') like @nipTmp + '%' and isnull(kns_nazwa,'') like '%' + @osoba + '%' ) or ( @soundTmp <> '' and knt_soundex = @soundTmp )
return END
